findings.what: The `on_dog_section` hunk adds only a comment and never sets `self.keymap_open = false`, so the overlay still survives the dog-section reply and the new `a_dog_sections_reply_that_lands_with_the_overlay_up_closes_it` test will fail.

`open_or_refresh_config_pane` also runs when an already-open pane is refreshed, so an overlay the operator raised on top of the pane now closes when a background refresh arrives, even though the body did not change to a different screen.
